description: This file defines the OLE class responsible for reading and parsing OLE (Object Linking and Embedding) compound document files, including handling of streams, PPS structures, and block allocation tables. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's shared utilities for OLE container processing.

classes.name: OLE
classes.description: Represents an OLE container; provides functionalities to read, parse, and access streams and properties of OLE files.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads an OLE container from a file, initializing block tables, PPS structures, and root directory.

methods.name: getBlockOffset
methods.description: Calculates the byte offset in the file for a given block ID.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides a stream resource to read the data associated with a specific block or PPS object.

methods.name: readInt1
methods.description: Reads a signed byte from the file handle.

methods.name: readInt2
methods.description: Reads an unsigned short (2 bytes), little-endian.

methods.name: readInt4
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte signed integer, considering two's complement representation.

methods.name: readPpsWks
methods.description: Reads the PPS (Property Storage Structure) workspace starting from a block ID, building a tree of PPS objects.

methods.name: ppsTreeComplete
methods.description: Recursively checks whether the PPS tree rooted at a given index is entirely read.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Determines if the PPS at a specific index is a file type.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Determines if the PPS at a specific index is a root type.

methods.name: ppsTotal
methods.description: Returns the total number of PPS objects parsed from the container.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves data from a specific PPS at a given position and length.

methods.name: getDataLength
methods.description: Returns the size of the data stored in a particular PPS.

methods.name: ascToUcs
methods.description: Converts an ASCII string to a Unicode string.

methods.name: localDateToOLE
methods.description: Encodes a timestamp into the OLE date format.

methods.name: OLE2LocalDate
methods.description: Decodes an 8-byte OLE date string into a Unix timestamp.
